label: Figure 5.2: The supply of sneakers
alt: Two parallel upward-sloping supply curves for sneakers, S1 to the left of S, with two leftward arrows and dashed lines showing quantity falling from Q to Q1 at price P.
caption: A rise in wages raises the cost of making sneakers, so supply falls: the curve shifts left from S to S<sub>1</sub>. At the same price P, producers now supply only Q<sub>1</sub> instead of Q.
